Nothing anonymous can see anything. readiness.one_liner: A CLI pipeline that pulls Toronto rental listings (from a Repliers feed or a CSV/JSON export), scores each address against two people's separate transit commutes via the Google Routes API with inclusive time thresholds, and emits a CSV plus a self-contained sortable HTML comparison table of the listings that work for both — with an optional Firebase-hosted, sign-in-gated web view of the same data.
